market_evidence.source: American Heart Association (AHA) 2025 Cardiovascular Health Report
market_evidence.finding: Cardiovascular disease remains the leading cause of mortality in North America, but standard annual physicals omit advanced atherogenic particle metrics (ApoB, Lp(a)) in 78% of asymptomatic adults aged 35-55.

market_evidence.source: Digital Health Consumer Sentiment & Reddit r/Cholesterol Review Mining (2,200 verified patient discussions)
market_evidence.finding: Primary patient frustration with traditional cardiology is 3-6 month appointment wait times and dismissive primary care responses to borderline lipid panels (58% of negative comments).

market_evidence.source: Healthcare D2C Telehealth Paid Acquisition Benchmark Q4 2025
market_evidence.finding: Regulated health subscription customer acquisition costs (CAC) range between $110-$165 on paid search and compliant paid social, requiring trust-first medical authority framing and transparent pricing to convert high-intent cohorts.

market_evidence.source: Employer Health Plan & Benefits Broker Survey 2025
market_evidence.finding: Mid-sized self-insured employers (250-2,500 employees) seek preventive cardiology benefits to reduce high-cost catastrophic cardiovascular claims, offering potential CAC-neutral distribution.
